failures.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
first_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(order_purchase_timestamp) as first_order_date
    FROM 
        orders
    WHERE 
        order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
    GROUP BY 
        customer_id
),
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id
    FROM 
        orders
    WHERE 
        order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp <= '2017-12-31'
),
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.first_order_date) as first_order_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT f.customer_id) as total_customers,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN f.customer_id END) as retained_customers
    FROM 
        first_half_2017_orders f
    LEFT JOIN 
        second_half_2017_orders s ON f.customer_id = s.customer_id
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM f.first_order_date)
)
SELECT 
    first_order_month,
    total_customers,
    retained_customers,
    ROUND((retained_customers * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_customers, 0)), 2) as retention_rate
FROM 
    monthly_retention
ORDER BY 
    first_order_month
LIMIT 6;

WITH 
gmv_2017 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
),
gmv_2018 AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(oi.price) AS gmv
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018
    GROUP BY 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)
)
SELECT 
    COALESCE(g17.month, g18.month) AS month,
    COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2017,
    COALESCE(g18.gmv, 0) AS gmv_2018,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ((COALESCE(g18.gmv, 0) - COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0)) / COALESCE(g17.gmv, 0)) * 100
    END AS growth_rate_percentage
FROM 
    gmv_2017 g17
FULL OUTER JOIN 
    gmv_2018 g18 ON g17.month = g18.month
ORDER BY 
    month
LIMIT 12;
